sentences.text: Shiriyanetta belongs to the family Anatidae, which includes ducks, geese, and swans, and is placed in the subfamily Mergini.
This species was a flightless seaduck, sharing a unique trait with the extinct Chendytes.
The species Shiriyanetta hasegawai was described by Watanabe and colleagues in 2015.
Fossils of Shiriyanetta date from the Mid Pleistocene to the Late Pleistocene, living between 0.774 and 0.0117 million years ago.
